neighbours.label: A colour word naming the shade of a yarn, fabric or material, after a shade adjective ('a pale green')
fire: The yarn she picked was a soft green with grey flecks.
Our second cardigan will be knit in a warm yellow with brown buttons.
He ordered the jacket in a deep red with black lining.
The tiles come in a muted blue or a pale yellow.
The blanket is woven in a dusty pink with white fringe.
She dyed the wool a rich purple for the winter shawl.
The couch is upholstered in a dark green with brass studs.
These socks are made in a light grey with navy stripes.
quiet: The yarn she picked was a soft cotton with thick flecks.
Our second cardigan will be knit in a warm wool with wooden buttons.
He ordered the jacket in a heavy tweed with silk lining.
The tiles come in a small square or a long oblong.
The blanket is woven in a coarse linen with knotted fringe.
She washed the wool in a big tub for the winter shawl.
The couch is upholstered in a smooth leather with brass studs.
These socks are made in a thin nylon with ribbed tops.
